section_summary: This section contains the end of a Furukawa–Siemens cable agreement, its supplementary papers, and a Furukawa–Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke light metals agreement with a codicil. Most of the pages then reproduce Gadelius manufacturing licences and agency agreements for industrial equipment and processes. The section ends at the beginning of a Solex carburettor licence.

people.name: H. G. Torulf
people.role: Named in the firm Allmänna Ingeniörsbyrån H. G. Torulf

people.name: Nils W. Jonsson
people.role: Party to the coarse screening machine agreement

people.name: Rob. Thune

subfiles.title: Long Distance Cable Agreement between Furukawa and Siemens, conclusion
subfiles.from: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.to: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.about: Concludes a cable technology agreement with royalty accounting, associated company, arbitration and duration clauses.
subfiles.summary: The closing clauses require twice-yearly royalty accounts, bind associated companies, prescribe arbitration in Switzerland, and set a ten-year term with possible extension. The agreement is signed at Berlin-Siemensstadt and Tokyo and supersedes the parties’ 1923 cable agreements.

subfiles.title: Supplementary Memorandum to the Long Distance Cable Agreement
subfiles.from: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.to: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.about: Sets sales territories, product preferences and compensation for long distance cable business.
subfiles.summary: Furukawa and Siemens undertake to cooperate on cables, Pupin coils and apparatus. They divide sales obligations in China, provide three-percent compensation for specified competing sales, and regulate Siemens’ supply of polystyrene to Furukawa.

subfiles.title: Memorandum Concerning the Amendment of Article 5 of the Long Distance Cable Agreement
subfiles.from: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.to: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.about: Amends Furukawa’s annual payment to Siemens for technical experience.
subfiles.summary: Sets a ¥25,000 annual payment, adjusted when the yen–sterling remittance rate varies by more than ten percent.

subfiles.title: List A of Associated Companies
subfiles.from: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.to: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.; Siemens & Halske AG
subfiles.about: Registers Furukawa companies covered by the long distance cable agreement.
subfiles.summary: Lists two Fuji companies in Tokyo and explains why Dainichi Densen in Osaka is excluded.

subfiles.title: Agreement about Co-operation between Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke and Furukawa Electric
subfiles.from: Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke GmbH; Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke GmbH; Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Exchanges patents and manufacturing experience for light metal semi-manufactures.
subfiles.summary: VLW grants Furukawa use of Japanese patents and German fabrication experience for light metal products, including aircraft materials, within defined territories. The agreement specifies technical instructions, engineer visits, secrecy, patent rights, substantial instalment payments, renewal and arbitration. An attached schedule lists eleven Japanese patent applications.

subfiles.title: Codicil to the Furukawa–VLW Agreement
subfiles.from: Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke GmbH; Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Vereinigte Leichtmetall-Werke GmbH; Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Revises the territory, training, payments and duration of the light metals agreement.
subfiles.summary: The codicil expands the territory to areas under Japanese supremacy, changes engineer training and wartime visit provisions, and substitutes free Reichsmark payments for the earlier sterling arrangements. It sets the first period to expire no later than December 1945 and a possible second period no later than December 1950.

subfiles.title: List of Firms with Whom Gadelius Has Manufacturing Licence Contracts
subfiles.from: Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Introduces a collection of Gadelius manufacturing licence contracts.
subfiles.summary: Cover sheet for the following licence agreements.

subfiles.title: Kamyr Bleaching and Acid Treatment System Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Kamyr; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Kamyr; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius to sell Kamyr pulp mill systems in Japan and Manchukuo.
subfiles.summary: Grants sole representation and sets a licence fee per ton of annual plant capacity through 1943.

subfiles.title: Kamyr Pump Manufacturing Contract
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Kamyr; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Kamyr; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.about: Grants Gadelius sole Japanese manufacturing rights for Kamyr pulp circulation and transport pumps.
subfiles.summary: Kamyr supplies drawings and technical experience, while Gadelius undertakes manufacture and sales in Japan and Manchukuo. Payment includes a lump sum and a ten-percent licence fee. The contract provides for confidentiality, remittance permits and renewal.

subfiles.title: Allmänna Ingeniörsbyrån Sintering System Agreement
subfiles.from: Allmänna Ingeniörsbyrån H. G. Torulf; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.to: Allmänna Ingeniörsbyrån H. G. Torulf; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole representative for the A.I.B. sintering system in Japan and China.
subfiles.summary: Gadelius is to promote and service sintering plants; the Swedish firm supplies drawings, expertise and machinery. The agreement allocates licence fees by plant capacity and protects confidential drawings.

subfiles.title: Particulars of Gadelius Contracts
subfiles.from: Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Lists licensed firms and the industrial products or processes they supply.
subfiles.summary: Indexes Gadelius contracts for regulators, pulp equipment, heat exchangers, steam equipment and other products.

subfiles.title: Arca Apparatus Manufacturing Agreement and Royalty Schedule
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Arca Regulatorer; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Arca Regulatorer; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.about: Permits Japanese manufacture of Arca apparatus when import permits cannot be obtained.
subfiles.summary: Arca supplies drawings and receives royalties on Japanese manufacture; the attached schedule gives Swedish-crown amounts for regulators and steam desuperheaters.

subfiles.title: Brobeck Circulation System Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole representative for Brobeck digester circulation systems.
subfiles.summary: Covers Japan and Manchukuo, sets a licence based on system value, and runs through 1943.

subfiles.title: Svensson Chip Filling System Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole representative for Svensson chip filling systems.
subfiles.summary: Covers Japan and Manchukuo, with a fee tied to digester volume and an initial term through 1943.

subfiles.title: Coarse Screening Machine Agreement
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Nils W. Jonsson; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget A. Ekströms Maskinaffär; Nils W. Jonsson; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.about: Grants Gadelius exclusive rights in Japan for specified coarse screening machines.
subfiles.summary: Sets per-machine royalties, sales reporting, drawings, a term through 1944, and Swedish arbitration.

subfiles.title: Terms for Manufacturing Sall Regulators in Japan
subfiles.from: Gadelius & Co. AB, Stockholm
subfiles.to: Gadelius office in Tokyo
subfiles.about: Confirms proposed terms for making Sall regulators for Japan and Manchukuo.
subfiles.summary: Specifies a per-regulator licence, yen deposits pending remittance permission, sales reports and technical information.

subfiles.title: Haglund Acid Producing System Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Industrimetoder; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Industrimetoder; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole representative for the Haglund acid producing system.
subfiles.summary: Covers Japan and Manchukuo, with a capacity-based licence fee and an initial term through 1943.

subfiles.title: Ljungström Air Preheater Licence Agreement
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Ljungströms Ångturbin; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Ljungströms Ångturbin; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Grants Gadelius exclusive Japanese manufacturing and sales rights for Ljungström air preheaters.
subfiles.summary: The fifteen-year licence governs territory, sublicences, drawings, improvements, manufacturing standards and patent protection. It requires initial cash payments and royalties, detailed accounts and reports, nameplates, and arbitration. Renewal and termination provisions preserve royalties on orders already taken.

subfiles.title: Northern Equipment Manufacturing Agreement
subfiles.from: Northern Equipment Co.; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Northern Equipment Co.; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Permits Gadelius to manufacture Northern Equipment regulator equipment in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Sets royalties and service charges, provides an engineer, and allows sales in Japan and Manchukuo.

subfiles.title: Rosenblad Spiral Heat Exchanger Licence
subfiles.from: AB Rosenblads Patenter; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: AB Rosenblads Patenter; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole representative for Rosenblad spiral heat exchangers.
subfiles.summary: Covers Japan and Manchukuo, with a fee per square metre of heating surface through 1943.

subfiles.title: Superior Soot Blower Manufacturing Licence Letter
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Superior
subfiles.to: Gadelius & Co. Aktiebolag, Stockholm
subfiles.about: Confirms terms for Japanese manufacture of Superior soot blowers.
subfiles.summary: Confirms a five-percent licence paid monthly and cessation of Japanese manufacture when normal imports resume.

subfiles.title: Syrefast Acid-Proof Mortar Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Syrefast Murning; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Syrefast Murning; Gadelius & Co.
subfiles.about: Licenses Gadelius to manufacture and sell Syrefast acid-proof mortar in Japan and Manchukuo.
subfiles.summary: Sets an initial payment credited against volume-based royalties, restricts disclosure of the formula, and provides for yen deposits while remittance permits are pending.

subfiles.title: Vaporackumulator Ruths Steam Accumulator Licence
subfiles.from: Aktiebolaget Vaporackumulator; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Aktiebolaget Vaporackumulator; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Grants Gadelius an exclusive Japanese licence for Ruths steam and hot water accumulators.
subfiles.summary: The fifteen-year agreement covers patent information, improvements, maintenance, confidentiality and sublicensing. It requires substantial initial payments and seven-percent royalties, with accounts twice yearly and a minimum royalty guarantee. Disputes are to be arbitrated under Swedish law.

subfiles.title: Yarnall-Waring Yarway Equipment Agreement
subfiles.from: Yarnall-Waring Company; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Yarnall-Waring Company; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Grants Gadelius exclusive Japanese manufacturing and sales rights for Yarway steam plant equipment.
subfiles.summary: The agreement sets a ten-percent royalty, remittance and exchange provisions, supply of drawings and parts, product marking, sales reports, and termination conditions.

subfiles.title: Supplemental Memorandum to the Yarway Agreement
subfiles.from: Yarnall-Waring Company; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: Yarnall-Waring Company; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Adds territorial and payment provisions to the Yarway licence.
subfiles.summary: Limits licensed production to Japanese-controlled territory, bars specified exports, and requires payment from other funds if Japanese remittance is delayed beyond three months.

subfiles.title: Pomilio Alkali-Chlorine Cellulose System Agreement
subfiles.from: S.A. Sindicato Cellulosa Pomilio; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.to: S.A. Sindicato Cellulosa Pomilio; Gadelius & Co., Ltd.
subfiles.about: Appoints Gadelius sole agent for the Pomilio cellulose system in Japan and Manchukuo.
subfiles.summary: Pomilio supplies technical data and drawings; Gadelius promotes the system and arranges local manufacture of much of the machinery. The agreement sets plant-capacity licence fees, payment and remittance procedures, patent costs, duration and arbitration. Page 143 contains a brief guarantee inserted among the agreement pages.

subfiles.title: Solex–Kokusan Kogyo Carburettor Agreement, opening
subfiles.from: Société Anonyme Solex; Kokusan Kogyo Kabushiki Kaisha
subfiles.to: Société Anonyme Solex; Kokusan Kogyo Kabushiki Kaisha
subfiles.about: Begins an exclusive licence to manufacture Solex carburettors in Japanese-controlled territories.
subfiles.summary: The opening clauses grant rights for several engine uses, permit sublicensing, require Solex to supply drawings and plant instructions, and specify a ¥60,000 documentation payment. The agreement continues beyond page 146.
